risk_description: Retriever fails to find the correct policy document
mitigation: Improve chunking; upgrade embedding model; expand golden dataset

risk_description: LLM hallucinates information not in retrieved context
mitigation: Strict system prompt; groundedness scoring; human review of escalated cases

risk_description: LLM incorrectly decides escalation not needed
mitigation: Review escalation rubric; add examples; monitor escalation accuracy
Compare against human evaluation; use multiple judge models

risk_description: User accidentally pastes customer PII into assistant
mitigation: Add input sanitisation; warn users; do not store queries

risk_description: Synthetic data does not represent real SME queries
mitigation: Validate against real SME data before production; expand dataset

risk_description: SPC flags are ignored or misinterpreted
mitigation: Train users on SPC interpretation; automate alerts for critical flags

risk_description: FAISS index becomes stale after document updates
mitigation: Re-index on document changes; document rebuild procedure
